goal: Skip issue-event workflow runners that cannot change a result: Destructive proposal checklist only for destructive-proposal issues; Issue orchestrator label skips title-only edits. No required status-check context changes.
prohibited_actions: do not touch any migration or database object
do not remove or rename any required status-check context
do not add a paths filter to a required check
assumptions: check-destructive-analysis.mjs already no-ops for issues without the destructive-proposal label
the orchestrator-label classifier reads only the issue body
stop_conditions: stop if a required context would change
